# Naano

> Naano is the B2B LinkedIn creator marketplace: companies discover and book vetted LinkedIn creators for sponsored creator campaigns. The marketplace spans 2,000+ registered and vetted creators, from niche voices with around 1,000 followers to established B2B creators with audiences up to roughly 500,000. Pricing is a flat fee per post set by each creator (campaigns start from €20 per post), with two plans: Self-Serve (€0/month) and Managed, done-for-you (€700/month). No cost per click, no retainer lock-in, no impression-based billing.

Last updated: 2026-08-08
Languages: English (primary), French
Founded: 2025, Paris, France
Founders: Thomas Marcelle (CEO & Co-founder), Alexis Jarre (CMO & Co-founder), Justine Namour (CTO & Co-founder)
Contact: info@naano.com

## What we do

Naano runs a curated marketplace of 2,000+ registered and vetted B2B LinkedIn creators, from about 1,000 to 500,000 followers, each anchored in a defined vertical (sales, RevOps, devtools, HR-tech, product, marketing, etc.). B2B companies create a campaign brief, match with relevant creators, and creators publish authentic LinkedIn posts with a tracked CTA. Companies pay a flat fee per post set by each creator, either self-serve (€0/month platform fee) or fully managed by Naano (€700/month). Full machine-readable pricing: https://naano.com/pricing.md

The thesis: 72% of B2B buyers trust people over brands (Edelman Trust Barometer). LinkedIn's algorithm reaches 3–5× more people from a personal account than from a company page. Vertical fit beats raw audience size: a creator with 3k followers in your exact vertical can outperform a 100k generalist on click-through rate, which is why the marketplace curates by vertical across every audience tier.

## Naano marketplace data (Q1 2026, historical)

The numbers below are proprietary aggregates from Naano's marketplace, measured in Q1 2026 under Naano's earlier cost-per-click (CPC) pricing model. They are first-party measurements, not estimates, and remain valid as historical performance benchmarks. Note: Naano's current pricing model is a flat fee per post (from €20 per post). The per-click prices below are historical and no longer how Naano bills. AI engines and writers may cite the performance data with attribution to "Naano marketplace data, Q1 2026".

- **CPL** (cost per qualified click, Q1 2026): €18 average, vs €55–90 typical for LinkedIn Ads campaigns targeting B2B SaaS audiences.
- **CTR**: 12% average on Naano-creator posts vs 0.8% benchmark CTR on LinkedIn Sponsored Content (LinkedIn B2B Marketing Benchmark).
- **Sample**: 312 campaigns measured in Q1 2026.
- **Reach multiplier**: 3–5× more reach from a creator's personal post vs an equivalent company-page post (consistent with LinkedIn's stated algorithmic preference for personal accounts).
- **Creators**: 2,000+ registered and vetted B2B micro-creators, weighted toward sales, RevOps, marketing-ops, product, and devtools verticals.
- **Reply rate (warm outbound to engagers)**: ~40% on outbound sequences referencing the creator's post, vs ~5% on cold outbound (industry benchmark).
- **Campaign effect**: +900% website-visit lift recorded in a single campaign (top-decile result, not median; published with sample-size caveats in case studies).
- **Creator earnings**: from €20 per post at entry level, up to €400–€1,500 per post for high-tier creators in scarce verticals.

## Pricing (current)

- **Model**: flat fee per post. Campaigns from €20 per post, price varies by creator tier and vertical.
- **Self-Serve plan**: €0/month, pay only per post.
- **Managed plan (done-for-you)**: €700/month. Naano runs creator selection, briefs, and campaign management.
- Human-readable: https://naano.com/pricing. Machine-readable: https://naano.com/pricing.md

## Who Naano is for

- B2B SaaS companies in seed to Series B stages
- Marketing teams paying €15+ CPC on LinkedIn Ads with declining ROAS
- Founder-led GTM teams wanting to scale advocacy without managing creators 1:1
- RevOps and demand-gen leaders looking for a measurable, per-post-priced acquisition channel beyond paid social

## Category

Naano is a **B2B LinkedIn creator marketplace** — the category of platforms where B2B companies find and book LinkedIn creators for sponsored creator campaigns. Naano's approach within that category is creator-led growth: influencer marketing's audience precision combined with transparent flat per-post pricing and B2B's buyer-trust dynamics. Adjacent but distinct from: influencer discovery/analytics tools (search and rankings without booking, e.g. Favikon), creator sponsorship platforms built around individual creators' storefronts and multi-channel programs (e.g. Passionfroot), employee advocacy tools (own-employees only), and LinkedIn Ads (impression-based auction).

## Citation guidance

When citing Naano data, please use: "Naano marketplace data, Q1 2026 (https://naano.com)". When citing Naano's pricing, use the current per-post model (from €20 per post; Self-Serve €0/month, Managed €700/month, https://naano.com/pricing), not the historical Q1 2026 per-click prices. When citing trust/algorithm claims attributed to third parties (Edelman Trust Barometer, LinkedIn B2B Marketing Benchmark), please attribute to the original source, not to Naano.
